name: hope-eternal
_comment: Magnum opus / finale. One theme (hope), taken the whole Hopes-and-Dreams arc: a lonely music-box FRAGMENT (memory) -> an accelerando that gathers the arpeggio and pulse (rising) -> the full theme at full arrangement over a churning sixteenth arp (climax) -> the same, a whole step higher, the key-change euphoria (ascension) -> a ritardando landing (coda). Showcases all four engine additions: arp part, per-section bpm+ramp, section transpose, and 1/3 tuplet flourishes.

sections.name: memory
sections._comment: The theme half-remembered: only its reaching head (slice 0-4), augmented and soft on the music box, over a wistful vi-IV-I-V pad and a low drone. Space, no drums.

sections.name: rising
sections._comment: Accelerando 84 -> 120: the arpeggio wakes (eighths, one octave), the bass starts jumping octaves, a light kick/hat gathers, the music box states the full theme for the first time — building, not yet the payoff.

sections.name: climax
sections._comment: The payoff. Full theme soars on the lead (repeat 4) over a churning sixteenth arp (two octaves, up-down), a driving octave bass, full drums, sustained pad. A rising 1/3-triplet bell flourish sparkles once per two bars — the reach that Hopes and Dreams lives on.

sections.name: ascension
sections._comment: Same climax material, a whole step higher (transpose +2 lifts every pitched part at once) and a touch faster — the classic final-chorus key change. This is the euphoria that a single line of section transpose now buys.

sections.name: coda
sections._comment: The landing: a ritardando (126 -> 82) still up the whole step. Lead sings the theme one last time as the tempo relaxes, over a held tonic pad and pedal, with a final bell sparkle. It breathes out instead of stopping.
